note: Steam trailer. [bar, beat] from 0 on a 128 BPM grid (beat 0.46875 s, bar 1.875 s). 31 bars = 58.125 s. Each act works in LOCAL bars (src/steam/cues.ts ACTS) and is shifted onto the film by `offsets` (global bar = local bar + offset). SFX cues in src/steam/sfx/<act>.json are LOCAL.
